title: A Steerable Deep Network for Model-Free Diffusion MRI Registration
abstract: arXiv:2501.04794v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Nonrigid registration is vital to medical image analysis but remains challenging for diffusion MRI (dMRI) due to its high-dimensional, spatio-angular dependence. We present a novel, geometric deep learning framework for model-free, nonrigid registration of raw dMRI data. We formulate registration in the native spatio-angular acquisition space under the joint action of 3D roto-translations, $\mathrm{SE}(3)$. Central to our framework is the equivalence between equivariant spatio-angular convolutions and 3D steerable convolutions on spherical-harmonic coefficient fields, which we exploit to construct an $\mathrm{SE}(3)$-equivariant U-Net. A by-product of this design choice is freedom from having to augment the data with roto-translated versions of itself. translated_title: 一种用于无模型扩散磁共振成像配准的可操纵深度网络
translated_abstract: 非刚性配准对医学图像分析至关重要，但由于扩散磁共振成像（dMRI）具有高维度和空间-角度依赖性，其非刚性配准仍然充满挑战。我们提出了一种新颖的几何深度学习框架，用于对原始dMRI数据进行无模型的非刚性配准。我们在三维旋转平移变换SE(3)的联合作用下，在原始的空间-角度采集空间中构建配准问题。我们框架的核心在于等变空间-角度卷积与作用于球谐系数场的三维可操纵卷积之间的等价性，我们利用这一等价性构建了SE(3)等变的U-Net网络。这一设计选择的附带好处是无需使用旋转平移版本的自身数据进行数据增强。我们还构建了水位移分布之间的最大均值差异损失，该损失在傅里叶空间中计算为信号差异平方的加权和……
tldr: 提出了一种基于SE(3)等变可操纵卷积的几何深度学习框架，实现了无需模型假设的原始扩散磁共振数据非刚性配准，且无需旋转平移数据增强。
en_tdlr: A geometric deep learning framework built on SE(3)-equivariant steerable convolutions enables model-free nonrigid registration of raw diffusion MRI data without requiring roto-translation data augmentation.
